A.passage:
<보기>
- Last night, there were a heavy rain.
- The streets was very wet.
- My shoes were dirty, but I was happy to get home.
- My parents was worried about me, so they were waiting in the living room.

핵심 규칙: be동사의 과거형은 단수 주어(셀 수 없는 명사 포함)에 was, 복수 주어에 were를 쓴다. there was/were는 뒤의 명사에 맞춘다.
